_comment: What ground that gives way under itself costs an Age's instability budget, and how far it can reach
Priced with the sandfall, the blizzard and the meteor storm, on the argument all four share: this is
difficulty you can answer rather than a verdict you cannot. What it asks of a player is to read the
floor, and three seconds of unmistakable fracture is a long time to get off a piece of ground -- where
an Age that goes on holing itself only asks how long you stay.
A step buys size and speed: how much ground one collapse takes, and how fast it goes once the warning
is over. It never buys the warning. That is the mechanism rather than a dial -- a collapse that arrived
unannounced would not be a harder version of this, it would be a different and worse thing.
Not the same register as `collapse`, which tears the world floor and ends the Age. This one only ever
takes the hillside you are standing on.
